english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a task or situation that looks difficult or challenging.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is extremely difficult.

examples.english: Getting this report in today is really daunting.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告要喺今日交，真係好難。

examples.english: This maths problem is fiendish; I’ve thought about it all morning and still can’t solve it.
examples.traditional: 呢條數學題好難，我諗咗成朝都未識做。
